title: IAM roles and temporary credentials

kcs.statement: An IAM role is an identity with permissions but no long-term password or access keys, assumed by a trusted entity such as an AWS service, an IAM user, another account or a federated user.
Assuming a role returns temporary credentials from AWS Security Token Service (STS) that expire automatically after a set duration.
An application running on EC2 should get its AWS permissions from a role attached to the instance rather than from access keys stored on the server.
